effects.description: If your Character [Bonk Punch] would be K.O.'d by an effect, you may trash this Character instead.
conditions: [Bonk Punch] would be K.O.'d by an effect
steps: (Optional) Trash [Bonk Punch] instead of letting it be K.O.'d
notes: You can choose not to use this effect and let [Bonk Punch] be K.O.'d
This effect only triggers when [Bonk Punch] would be K.O.'d by an effect, not by battle
